title: tsdk-deferred-type-stamping-and-multi-pass-discriminator-resolution
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Problem: when generating TypeScript SDK types from model schemas and JSON-schema artifacts we encounter ambiguous discriminator cases at runtime (partial streaming payloads, missing tags, and model drift). Existing single-pass discriminator resolution causes frequent runtime fallsbacks or brittle developer-facing types. Goal: implement a deferred type-stamping approach plus a multi-pass discriminator resolution algorithm that works with incremental/streaming responses and integrates with Zod/JSON-schema helpers for graceful ergonomics and clear diagnostics.
acceptance_criteria: 1) SDK can accept streaming JSON chunks and incrementally resolve union types without rejecting on the first ambiguous token; 2) Zod helper exposes .deferred() and .confidence() helpers that accept partial payloads and return a stamped TypeScript type once resolved; 3) Type generation emits lightweight runtime discriminator maps for production with minimal bundle impact; 4) End-to-end tests for 3 representative union schemas (chat message variants, tool-call result, metadata events) pass under simulated model drift and truncated streams.
design_decision_notes: We will not attempt full probabilistic inference in the SDK (too heavy). Instead adopt a hybrid: 1) deferred-stamping holds an envelope with 'unknown' during streaming and applies lightweight heuristics (tag presence, field-set scoring, shape fingerprints) on the finalization or when confidence crosses threshold; 2) runtime heuristics are pluggable so integrators can provide domain-specific resolvers; 3) Zod adapters will expose a streaming-parse mode that can be toggled per-call to minimize perf impact.
tradeoffs:
- Pro: fewer false rejections and better developer experience for streaming outputs.
- Con: slightly more runtime work and temporary allocations during streaming parsing.
- Con: generated artifacts include small discriminator maps which modestly increase bundle size; mitigated by tree-shaking-friendly design and opt-in generation.
implementation_outline: 1) Typegen: add a new 'deferred' flag on union type outputs and emit a <Type>Deferred wrapper and a runtime discriminator map file. 2) Runtime: implement multi-pass resolver that scores candidate variants on each chunk, promotes winner when confidence > 0.9 or on stream end. 3) Zod/JSON-schema helpers: add z.deferredUnion(schemaList, options) which returns {parseStream, parseFull, getConfidence}. 4) Examples: update 'chat-tooling' example to show streaming tool-call resolution and a 'fallback-to-json' policy. 5) Tests/benchmarks: microbench for overhead, integration tests for partial JSON and model drift scenarios.
notes_on_streaming_ergonomics:
- parseStream yields a lightweight envelope immediately (id, partialFields, provisionalType) and an async iterator of events.
- Provide a developer helper await stamped() which resolves to the concrete typed object once resolved or throws a well-typed StampingError if ambiguous at stream end.
- Developer can pass resolvePolicy: ['confidence', 'tag-first', 'last-chunk'] to tune behavior.
examples_to_ship:
- examples/tsdk/streaming-toolcall-deferred.md (show streaming parse, stamped() usage, and fallback).
- examples/tsdk/chat-event-union.md (incremental typing of message variants).
- snippets for z.deferredUnion with custom resolver hook.
comments: 2026-03-11 - Aisha: Prototype of multi-pass resolver complete. Initial heuristics: tag presence (weight 0.7), required-field match (0.5), extra-field penalty (-0.3). Performance rough numbers: ~1.8x parse cost on small payloads when streaming mode enabled.

2026-03-12 - Liam: Reviewed prototype; asked for opt-in schema generation and a strategy for minimizing bundle size (split runtime map into lazy-loaded shards). Also requested telemetry hooks for ambiguous resolutions.

2026-03-13 - Aisha: Added telemetry hook (resolve.event) and opt-in generation flag `--emit-deferred-maps`. Updated tests to include drifted schema example where discriminator tag is renamed by model.

2026-03-14 - Liam: Implemented z.deferredUnion API surface and basic parseStream iterator. Found an edge-case where arrays inside unions confuse fingerprinting; added fingerprint normalization step. Next: write integration examples and file PR for internal review.
